spans.s: शोकः [śōkḥ], [शुच्-घञ्] Sorrow, grief, distress, affliction, lamentation, wailing, deep anguish; श्लोकत्वमापद्यत यस्य शोकः

. -Comp. -अग्निः, -अनलः the fire of grief. -अपनोदः removal of grief. -अभिभूत, -आकुल, -आविष्ट, -उपहत, -विह्वल a. afflicted or agonized by grief. -अरिः the Kadamba tree. -कर्षित a. afflicted or agonized with grief. -चर्चा indulgence in grief. -नाशः the Aśoka tree. -निहत a. overcome with sarrow.-परायण, -लासक a. engrossed in grief, wholly given up to grief. -रुग्ण a. broken down with sarrow. -विकलa. overwhelmed with grief. -स्थानम् any cause of sorrow.
